Good enough, Requires UI refinements. 
As someone who works with blockchian, it was intuitive enough. For general public it might be confusing to understand what "enabling SUSD" or Approving means. 
Also all the buttons changes states if one of them is active, eg: if we are in process of Approving SUSD, UI shows Locking and Signing.. button active. And this feedback box is very tiny, I cannot edit my text now. :)
very immersive experience. would recommend to everyone. execution was smooth and easy to understand.
It is fine, confusing but is nice. Can do better with the UI
